versions.changelog:
xyq-short-drama-skill v1.0.3

- Added detailed usage documentation (SKILL.md) covering all main flows, including submission, querying, uploading, file retrieval, and download of short drama creations.
- Clarified role responsibilities between backend and user-side agents, as well as host-specific behaviors for input and browser flows.
- Defined strict principles for form/question option cleaning to ensure only appropriate workflow steps are presented to the user.
- Documented typical work scenarios to guide correct orchestration of commands, asset management, and result presentation.
- Outlined host source statistics and explicit support for major environments (Codex, WorkBuddy, TRAE Work) with integration instructions.
